# ContextSpindle

ContextSpindle is a local, bounded, persistent context memory engine for AI agents. It stores selected constraints, decisions, and root-cause fixes across sessions and uses a deterministic retrieval algorithm for a fixed snapshot, query, and configuration.

DiffHound is a PR review application built on the memory engine.

## Local setup

```bash
cargo install --path crates/continuum-cli
contextspindle init .
contextspindle remember "RULE: Never commit API keys"
contextspindle recall "API key rule" 3
contextspindle mcp
```

The MCP server advertises `contextspindle_remember`, `contextspindle_recall`, and `contextspindle_stats`. The old `continuum_*` tool calls and `continuum-cli` executable remain accepted during migration.

The local snapshot path is still `.continuum/memory.state`, preserving older data. Retrieval is selective and bounded; evicted events cannot be promised. A deterministic memory lookup does not make an agent's language-model response deterministic.

Repository: https://github.com/reacherwu/diffhound
Current naming decision: docs/NAME-CHANGE.md
Research and benchmark evidence: docs/BENCHMARKS.md and experiments/results/
